correctness.rationale: The repaired proof certifies the full scheme over the algebraic closure, not merely the rational projective stabilizer. The frozen proof inferred reducedness of the Fano scheme from its reduced row-echelon cell intersections, which can miss nilpotent directions transverse to a cell. The corrected proof uses adjunction on each line of the smooth K3 to give N_(L/X)=O_P1(-2) and hence zero Hilbert-scheme tangent space. In my separate replay, the four full Jacobian ideals are unit, and on all six full affine Plücker opens the restriction-coefficient ideals contain a²+a for each of the four chart variables. Those quotient algebras are split reduced, with open point counts 3,3,2,2,3,2 and union exactly the five listed lines. Their graph is A3 disjoint union A2. Each permutation defines homogeneous linear conditions over F2; exhausting all 65536 binary matrices gives exactly two vectors (zero and one nonzero) for each system, proving nullity one over every extension. The path reversals have singular lifts; the edge-only reversal has a unique invertible candidate but creates the absent X0²X3² monomial. The stabilizer acts on a split finite étale line scheme, and each permutation fiber lies scheme-theoretically inside its linear projectivization P0; the only surviving fiber is the reduced identity. Complete corrected affected files are under /workspace/repairs/4/; independent replay: python3 /workspace/checks/4.py (SymPy).
